config.translation.engine: Engine for dictionary misses, paragraphs and pages. Existing installations keep AI. Offline dictionary hits remain local in every mode. Online translation requires separate local permission for each service. [Choose in the sidebar](command:translateAnywhere.openSidebar).
config.engine.ai: Use your existing VS Code model or AI API.
config.engine.online: Use a token-free online translation service (separate permission required).
config.engine.offline: Only local dictionary lookups; no online or AI translations.
config.online.provider: Google uses an unofficial experimental endpoint: it may be unavailable, blocked or rate-limited. MyMemory offers a documented anonymous API with 5,000 characters/day; its policy permits text retention and partner sharing. Never send confidential text or code. No automatic fallback to other services.
config.online.sourceLanguage: Source language for online translation. Both services detect it automatically by default. MyMemory limits each request to 500 UTF-8 bytes; longer text is split without discarding content.
displayName: 翻译 Translate Anywhere · 划词翻译 · 全文翻译 · Select & Hover Translator
description: Select text in Chat, Markdown preview, Release Notes, Settings and more, then hover the red dot for an instant dictionary or AI translation. Paragraph and full-page translation included. 翻译 · 划词翻译 · 段落翻译 · 全文翻译 · 中英翻译 · AI 翻译
config.targetLanguage:
💡 **Easier in the sidebar:** [open the Translate Anywhere sidebar](command:translateAnywhere.openSidebar) to choose an engine/model, record shortcuts, style the dot and browse vocabulary.

Target language. Offline dictionaries provide Chinese definitions; other targets require the selected AI or online engine.
config.uiLanguage: Language of the popup, notifications and messages. `auto` follows the VS Code display language.
config.surfaces: Where selection translation and the paragraph/page shortcuts are active. Text editors are never affected.
config.surfaces.chat: Chat (responses, question boxes, tool confirmations, input notices)
config.surfaces.workbenchUI: Notifications, dialogs, hover cards, Workspace Trust and view messages
config.shortcuts.paragraph: Shortcut that translates (or restores) the paragraph under the mouse, e.g. `Alt+Z` or `Ctrl+Shift+Y`. Leave empty to disable. Outside supported surfaces the key keeps its normal VS Code meaning. These shortcuts are handled inside the page, so they are configured here rather than in Keyboard Shortcuts. [Set it in the sidebar](command:translateAnywhere.openSidebar?%5B%22scParagraph%22%5D).
config.shortcuts.fullPage: Shortcut that toggles full-page translation of the surface you are working in, e.g. `Alt+W`. Leave empty to disable. [Set it in the sidebar](command:translateAnywhere.openSidebar?%5B%22scFullPage%22%5D).
config.dot.size: Size of the dot that appears after you select text, in pixels. Click the dot in the Translate Anywhere sidebar to adjust it with a live preview or to use your own image. [Set it in the sidebar](command:translateAnywhere.openSidebar?%5B%22dotEditor%22%5D).
config.dot.color: Fill color of the selection dot (ignored while a custom image is set).
config.dot.borderWidth: Border width of the selection dot in pixels; `0` = no border.
config.dot.borderColor: Border color of the selection dot.
config.dot.opacity: Opacity of the selection dot while the mouse is not on it (`0.2`–`1`).
config.shortcuts.error: Use modifiers joined with + and one key, e.g. Alt+Z, Ctrl+Shift+Y or F8. Leave empty to disable.
config.fullPage.mode.translationOnly: Translation only: replace the original text (press the shortcut again to restore).
config.fullPage.mode.bilingual: Bilingual: show the translation below the original.
config.ai.autoTranslate: Automatically use the selected translation engine when the offline dictionary has no entry. Applies to AI and online translation; ignored in offline-only mode. When off, click the translate button in the popup. The setting name is retained for compatibility.
config.ai.modelId: VS Code language model used when **AI Provider** is `VS Code Language Models`. Only models visible in VS Code's **Language Models** view are offered. On a fresh install a small, fast model you have is picked; if none is found, the sidebar asks you to choose. **Test speed** in the sidebar measures your models and asks a lightweight one of them which ones suit translation; those appear as *Recommended*. [Set it in the sidebar](command:translateAnywhere.openSidebar?%5B%22modelId%22%5D).
config.integration.enabled: Consent to add a reversible UI script to the local VS Code installation (required for translation in Chat, previews and Settings). Use **Translate Anywhere: Disable and Restore VS Code** to remove it.
config.integration.autoRepair: Reapply the UI integration automatically after VS Code updates replace its files.
config.ai.provider: Which AI service translates phrases, sentences and paragraphs. `VS Code Language Models` uses models you already have in VS Code (for example GitHub Copilot) and needs no API key. Other providers call their HTTP API directly with a key stored in VS Code's encrypted Secret Storage (set it with **Translate Anywhere: Set API Key**). [Set it in the sidebar](command:translateAnywhere.openSidebar?%5B%22provider%22%5D).
config.ai.apiModel: Model name for the selected HTTP provider, e.g. `gpt-4o-mini`, `claude-haiku-4-5`, `deepseek-chat`, `qwen-flash`. Empty = the provider's default lightweight model.
config.ai.baseUrl: Override the API base URL of the selected HTTP provider (OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic), e.g. a proxy, Azure-compatible gateway or `http://localhost:11434/v1` for Ollama. Required for the `Custom` provider. Empty = the provider's default.
config.ai.baseUrl.error: Enter an http:// or https:// URL, or leave empty.
config.dictionary.autoDownload: Download the offline English-Chinese dictionary (ECDICT, about 15 MB) on first use. It is fetched from GitHub with jsDelivr mirrors as fallbacks and verified with SHA-256. Not needed if you installed the offline VSIX or set **Dictionary: Path**.
config.dictionary.path: Absolute path of a local dictionary file (`.json.gz`, the same format as the published `dictionary.json.gz`). Overrides the bundled and downloaded dictionaries. Empty = default.
config.dictionary.downloadUrl: Extra HTTPS URL tried first when downloading the dictionary, e.g. an internal mirror. The file must match the published SHA-256.
config.dictionary.downloadUrl.error: Enter an https:// URL, or leave empty.
config.dictionary.german: Look up German words in the offline German–Chinese dictionary ([HanDeDict](https://handedict.zydeo.net/), CC BY-SA 3.0), downloaded once (about 3 MB) on first use. Unavailable entries and phrases use the selected AI or online engine unless offline-only mode is selected.
